annotations.title: Count 中国香港特别行政区 Working Days

description:
Use this when you need an auditable 中国香港特别行政区 working-day count. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when this package is the Hong Kong general/public-holiday calendar. Statutory employee holidays, employer rest days, school calendars, bank/exchange closures and private-sector arrangements are not inferred.
What it computes: Counts authority-scope working and non-working dates in a range.
Example user requests: Count 中国香港特别行政区 working days around 2027 Lunar New Year substitute. | Count 中国香港特别行政区 working days around 2026 Ching Ming substitution.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2027-02-06","end_date":"2027-02-10","include_start_date":true,"include_end_date":true}
Outputs: working_days, non_working_days, public_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: for each included date: working_days += status.is_working_day
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/hong-kong-general-holidays-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/hong-kong-general-holidays-working-days-between.md
name: count_hk_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Hong Kong general holidays under the General Holidays Ordinance; government/general public calendar only

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.
